fCn8zs912OE.text: I won't say it's easy , but it's easier than you might think. Word use follows a power law distribution in all languages ( Zipf's Law, [VIDEO] is an excellent vsauce cover of the subject ), but the short of it is that within a relatively short amount of time spent studying you'll be able to pick out common words and build from there, even if you started from zero.
